objective: Establish, by execution rather than by inventory, that this lab can generate and absorb a correct regular wave - the one prerequisite every seakeeping and added-resistance claim rests on - and thereby convert the naval capability gap map from a statement about a filesystem into a statement about this lab
rationale: The deliverable Katie asked for on this item was the capability gap map, honest about what is missing, and that map is written and committed at demo-output/website/campaign/NAVAL_CAPABILITY_GAP_MAP.md at zero compute. It refutes the premise it was commissioned under. docs/DOCKET.md G4 assumed seakeeping needs wave BCs we may not have; we have them. The install carries nine wave theories confirmed by runtime-selection symbols in libwaveModels.so, the waveAlpha and waveVelocity boundary conditions, activeAbsorption at the generating patch, five wave-maker types, fifteen wave tutorials, the full six-degree-of-freedom stack and overset multiphase. What the map found instead is docket B7's defect in its purest form: configured is not active. Across the tracked repo, zero files reference waveAlpha, waveVelocity or waveModel, while the identical pipeline finds 1,825 files mentioning alpha.water and 91 mentioning interFoam; zero waveProperties dictionaries exist anywhere in the repo including gitignored paths, against 345 transportProperties by the identical find. This lab has never generated a wave. Every capability claim in that map is therefore a property of an installation, and this proposal is the smallest purchase that changes that. It deliberately does NOT propose added resistance. The map records two structural absences that put spectral seas out of reach without new development - no named spectra, so JONSWAP or Pierson-Moskowitz must be discretised by us into explicit component tables, and no relaxation zones in either the ESI-native or the third-party form, so our only absorber is one shallowWaterAbsorption outlet patch where the literature we would compare against uses relaxation zones. Proposing added resistance now would be proposing a number we cannot yet defend
gate: Two stages, each with its criterion declared before any solve. Stage W1, the shipped stokesI tutorial run unmodified: PASS if it completes with bounded alpha and a wave train visibly propagating and absorbing, which converts the gap map's section 2 from installation inventory to lab capability; FAIL, reported as a result, if the shipped tutorial does not run here, which would itself be a finding about this release-candidate install. Stage W2, regular-wave verification: measured wave height and celerity at a mid-domain probe against the analytic Stokes solution for the same period and depth, on three mesh rungs, with the probe location, the averaging window, the transient-rejection cut and the number of wave periods sampled all pinned in the pre-registration on the F7a_REGATE_SPEC.md pattern before the first solve. PASS if height and celerity land inside a declared band on the two finer rungs with monotone improvement; FAIL if outside with a settled signal; NO VERDICT per docket B2 if the reflection check trips - specifically if the measured wave height varies along the flume by more than the declared band, which would indicate the single absorbing outlet patch is reflecting and would mean the flume, not the wave model, is what was measured
cost_basis: estimate with low confidence and no measured anchor, because no wave case has ever been timed on this machine. Stage W1 at 5 to 15 core-min prices one shipped 2-D flume tutorial, whose domains are small by construction. Stage W2 at 60 to 120 core-min prices three rungs of the same 2-D flume run long enough for the ramp plus several wave periods, noting that the absence of setWaves means the domain starts flat and the train must propagate in over rampTime, which is simulated time and therefore compute that a relaxation-zone code would not spend. Total taken at the upper-middle of the combined band. This is the cheapest item on the naval line by an order of magnitude and it gates the credibility of every other naval estimate, all of which currently inherit the fact that no marine case has ever been costed here
expected_knowledge_gain: The gap map's central finding is that we own untested machinery, and this converts that from a gap into either a capability or a defect. A pass makes every capability claim in the map a lab property rather than a filesystem property and unblocks the seakeeping ladder's rung S3, from which regular-wave added resistance at S5 becomes a fundable proposal with a measured cost basis. A fail on either stage is more valuable than a pass, because it would be discovered at roughly 135 core-min instead of inside a multi-thousand core-min ship-in-waves case. The reflection check specifically prices the one technical risk the map identifies as genuine: whether patch-local absorption holds up without relaxation zones, which is the question that decides whether added resistance is measurable here at all, since a reflecting outlet contaminates the very mean force the quantity is defined as
hard_criterion_note: No wave case has ever existed in this lab; the gap map establishes that by two positive-controlled searches. Hardness is real but the cost is small, which is the argument for buying this before any hull

launch_prompt: Naval wave-generation capability step. NOT blocked by the F7a ladder - no hull is involved. Step 1, zero compute: read demo-output/website/campaign/NAVAL_CAPABILITY_GAP_MAP.md in full, including section 6A's limits on its own negatives. Step 2: run the shipped tutorial multiphase/interFoam/laminar/waves/stokesI UNMODIFIED. Do not adapt, do not tune, do not substitute a different wave model - the point is to test the shipped configuration. Report completion, alpha boundedness from the log, and whether a train propagates and absorbs. Step 3, zero compute: write the stage W2 pre-registration - probe location, averaging window, transient-rejection cut, number of wave periods sampled, the analytic Stokes height and celerity for the tutorial's own period and depth, the tolerance band, and the along-flume reflection check whose failure yields NO VERDICT. Step 4: three mesh rungs of the same flume. Do NOT proceed to any hull, any irregular sea or any added-resistance quantity on this item; the map explains why spectral seas need new development first. Budget 135 core-min, hard stop at the stage boundary; setsid, launch_solve.sh registered, collector armed, nothing left running. Record: evidence file in demo-output/website/campaign/, birth certificate per docs/standards/MESH_STANDARD.md section 6 and its marine section, docket update on G4, honest verdict, and update the gap map's section 4 from never-exercised to whatever the truth then is.
